newsitem.title: USA: Loral to buy rest of Space Systems/Loral.
newsitem.headline: Loral to buy rest of Space Systems/Loral.

text.p: Loral Space & Communications Ltd said Monday it completed talks to acquire the remaining 49 percent stake in Space Systems/Loral that it does not already own for $374 million.
The space and communications technology company said it would pay $93 million in cash, $131 million in stock, and $150 million in convertible preferred equivalent obligations.
The 49 percent stake in Space Systems/Loral is being sold by Loral Space's four European alliance partners -- Aerospatiale, Alcatel Espace, Alenia Spazio SpA and Daimler-Benz Aerospace AG.
The partners, with the exception of Daimler-Benz, will receive equity securities in Loral and continue to be represented on Space Systems/Loral's board of directors.
The German company elected to receive a cash payment for its interests.
All the partners will continue their working relationship with Space Systems/Loral in the marketing and manufacture of satellites.
Space Systems/Loral will become a wholly-owned subsidiary of New York-based Loral.
The transaction is expected to close within 45 days.
Space Systems/Loral makes telecommunications, weather and direct broadcast satellites. Its had revenues of $1.4 billion, with a funded backlog of $1.5 billion, in 1996.
Loral's stock rose 25 cents to $17 on the New York Stock Exchange at mid-morning.
